validity.controls_basis: 3 frozen corpus controls + 3 current canonical schemas
validity.note: controls are frozen at corpus base; if a control is rejected the suite may not be used as current-revision calibration evidence until the lead resolves the blocker

adjudication_required.finding: the three frozen controls were authored against corpus base 92406957234f; the current canonical C0 moved the finite_codimension_complement -> residual_comeager row from transfer_failures to transfer_holds, so canonical gate rule R28 rejects all three controls. The control basis for any current-revision run is therefore invalid until the lead either rebases the controls to the current canonical layouts or pins the gate revision used for calibration.
adjudication_required.falsifier: a run of the frozen controls against the current binding gate that accepts all three, or a canonical C0 whose transfer_holds places that row in transfer_failures

adjudication_required.false_positive_note: canonical schemas end at their own class id

adjudication_required.false_positive_note: all three present in canonical SCC schemas

adjudication_required.delta: no extra key under `regularity` may name another differentiability class

adjudication_required.delta: `kind == full_measure` ⇒ measure wording, and no comeager wording (non-transferable)

adjudication_required.false_positive_note: C0 “boundary that is not regular”, C2 “not future geodesically complete”, WCC “future geodesically incomplete” all match

adjudication_required.delta: curvature-invariant hypotheses banned anywhere in a C0 schema
adjudication_required.false_positive_note: canonical schemas mention curvature only in exclusion lists (exempt paths)

adjudication_required.delta: the whole `i_plus` block is scanned for conclusion import, including `completeness_definition`

adjudication_required.delta: no sibling-class id or twice-differentiable paraphrase inside `conclusion`
adjudication_required.false_positive_note: canonical `conclusion` names the sibling only inside `forbidden_strengthenings` (exempt)

adjudication_required.delta: visibility paraphrase tokens (“seen by an observer at infinity”, …) in SCC `conclusion`/`falsifier`
adjudication_required.false_positive_note: canonical SCC falsifiers are extension witnesses

adjudication_required.delta: source role/note prose claiming to establish/prove/settle the class conclusion

adjudication_required.delta: `one_way_entailments` may not contain the converse C2 ⇒ C0 or a WCC transfer

adjudication_required.finding: SEM-1: no mechanical rule decides non-meagerness of the extendible set.
adjudication_required.falsifier: a decidable criterion for non-meagerness that two independent readers resolve identically

adjudication_required.finding: SEM-2: whether a wording leak changes the mathematical class cannot be decided by the runner.
adjudication_required.falsifier: a class-change witness that is machine-checkable per leak family

adjudication_required.finding: SEM-3: truth, non-vacuity and physical correctness of a schema are out of scope for any structural gate.
adjudication_required.falsifier: not falsifiable by a structural corpus; requires the numerics/audit gates
